accepted_outcome_work.interpretation: conditional descriptive mechanism evidence only; never a replacement for unconditional intention-to-treat quality
accepted_outcome_work.primary_comparison: within each task, compare only matched repetitions accepted in both arms, average eligible repetition differences within task, then summarize tasks equally
accepted_outcome_work.selection_warning: conditioning on acceptance can select different outcomes by arm; always report unconditional quality beside this analysis
accepted_outcome_work.unmatched_arm_accepted_summaries: report separately by arm and task as descriptive selected populations; do not use them for a causal work claim

analysis.analysis_population: all frozen randomized cells; accepted outcomes, evaluator failures, empty patches, subject failures, and timeouts remain assigned to their frozen arm under intention-to-treat semantics
claim_boundaries: no monetary-savings claim without provider-reported amount and currency
analysis.discordance: report matched-repetition both-accepted, both-negative, baseline-only, and treatment-only counts plus task-level acceptance patterns
analysis.incomplete_task_clusters: exclude incomplete task clusters from the primary paired estimate without imputation; retain every admissible cell in marginal summaries and report arm/reason missingness plus best-case and worst-case acceptance bounds
analysis.leave_one_task_out: recompute paired acceptance and every paired work summary after omitting each complete task cluster once
analysis.marginal_acceptance: report accepted numerator, admissible denominator, and rate separately by arm across all admissible cells
analysis.paired_acceptance: average the two binary repetitions within each arm and task, subtract baseline from treatment, then average complete task clusters equally
analysis.task_uncertainty: for N complete clusters, exhaust all N^N ordered task-cluster bootstrap resamples; use equal task weights and nearest-rank 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; do not resample cells independently
analysis.unconditional_work: for every durable work measure, average repetitions within arm and complete task, compare arms at task level, and also report arm-level marginal distributions over all admissible cells

rules: valid negative outcomes are never rerun
each infrastructure-invalid cell may restart at most once only while batch capacity remains
all attempt categories share the per-cell maximum
allowances never increase after freeze or outcome review
contradictory or multiple terminal identities stop the batch
malformed or contradictory durable evidence stops the batch
exhausted required allowance or per-cell capacity stops the batch with preserved missingness

rules.failure_feedback_available: provide named failing checks only and permit the single corrective round
rules.failure_feedback_unavailable: valid negative outcome; no invented feedback and no correction

decision: EXPLORATORY DESIGN QUALIFIED — TASK SELECTION AND FREEZE REQUIRE SEPARATE AUTHORIZATION

isolation_and_durability.ledger: fsynced canonical JSONL SHA-256 hash chain
isolation_and_durability.receipt_boundary: construct a receipt only after required durable official evaluator evidence and credential-cleanup evidence exist

operator_pause.mid_attempt: record cause contemporaneously before outcome review; preserve the interrupted attempt immutably; restart only with the next attempt number in fresh isolation if operator allowance and per-cell capacity remain
operator_pause.planned: only between cells before attempt_started; record before outcome review and consume no interruption allowance

retirement_gates.trigger: the same task shows treatment-caused suppression or removal of necessary correctness work in both repetitions, or one such event recurs on two task clusters

paired task-level treatment acceptance is below baseline and baseline-only discordant task clusters outnumber treatment-only clusters; only prospectively classified arm-independent infrastructure missingness may explain the pattern
jointly accepted matched comparisons do not show both a concrete evidence-supported removal or simplification of unsupported optional work and a reduction in at least one trajectory work measure
the treatment task-cluster mean is higher and more complete task clusters increase than decrease
the treatment task-cluster mean for local read/search or completed web search is higher and more complete task clusters increase than decrease
the treatment task-cluster mean for cached input is higher and more complete task clusters increase than decrease
the treatment task-cluster mean for wall time or another trajectory work measure is higher and more complete task clusters increase than decrease
the apparent benefit exists only in changed files, lines, dependencies, or another final-patch size diagnostic without accepted-outcome trajectory-work evidence
durable trajectory evidence shows the treatment changing ordinary discovery, correctness, or integration work before its frozen activation boundary
durable trajectory evidence shows up-front literal narrowing, reuse hunting, or other behavior materially equivalent to C-short v0.1
the final review initiates broad proof-of-minimality searching in both repetitions of one task or on two task clusters

sample_size_rationale: Eight repository-distinct task clusters cover all eight languages in the frozen source frame while keeping 32 subject cells and evaluator work bounded. Two repetitions per arm expose within-task instability, replicated correctness suppression, and mechanism consistency. This is not a power calculation and uses no Pilot-v3 effect size.

schedule_algorithm.arm_order: derive one orientation bit per opaque task commitment by SHA-256; repetition 1 uses that arm order and repetition 2 reverses it, so every task is baseline-first once and treatment-first once
schedule_algorithm.block_order: rank all task-repetition blocks by SHA-256 of schedule seed, future pool commitment, opaque task commitment, and repetition; execute each two-arm block contiguously
schedule_algorithm.ties: break only by opaque task commitment and repetition

selection.contamination_boundary: known development, Pilot, successor, continuation, canary, replacement, evaluator-failure, task-body, patch, and outcome details never affect eligibility, rank, sample size, or schedule
eligibility: member of the frozen SWE-bench-Live MultiLang source snapshot
member of the reconstructable post-Pilot-v3 opaque reserve commitment
repository and task absent from every development, Pilot-v1, Pilot-v2, Pilot-v3, successor, continuation, canary, and host-qualification replacement exposure
language is one of c, cpp, cs, go, java, js, rust, or ts
pinned host and container image are feasible
official evaluator and nonempty rebuild, fail-to-pass, pass-to-pass, and test commands are available
selection.exploratory_partition: at a separately authorized selection goal, carve exactly eight repositories from the current opaque reserve into a new exploratory-only partition
selection.ranking: for each language in fixed order, sort eligible candidates by SHA-256 of selection seed, source revision, language, and opaque instance identity; choose the first repository not already selected
selection.reserve_recommitment: after future selection, exclude every task from each selected repository and publish only remaining task count, repository count, and a domain-separated SHA-256 commitment over cryptographically ranked remaining opaque identities; emit no remaining identity or body
